about.intro: I'm a *Data Science and ML Student* who also loves building **modern** and **interactive** web applications.
about.description: I'm someone who enjoys **training models** and turning ideas into real-world tools. I primarily focus on *data science* but I also love building **websites**, **AI apps**, and **web interfaces**.
about.full:
Hi, I'm **Abhishek Kumar**, a Data Science and Machine Learning student from India. Over the past few years, I have been actively learning about data, algorithms, and AI while also building projects and exploring new web technologies.

I primarily focus on data science and machine learning, but I also really enjoy web development. I love using tools like *React*, *Next.js*, *Python*, *Node.js*, and *Tailwind CSS*. I like creating databases, training models, and building cloud-based apps.

Apart from data science, I'm deeply interested in *Artificial Intelligence*, *System Design*, and building full websites. I enjoy testing out new frameworks and tools because every new project teaches me something very useful.

I strongly believe that great software should be **simple**, **clean**, **fast**, and **easy to use**. Every project I build is a chance to solve real problems while improving my technical and coding skills.

My main goal is to become a highly skilled Machine Learning Engineer and Developer capable of building smart systems, creating useful products, and always learning new things.

projects.title: Energy Calculator Chatbot
projects.description: An AI chatbot that estimates household energy use from appliance details such as power, quantity, and daily usage. It provides quick country-aware results and clear suggestions to help users understand and reduce electricity consumption.

projects.title: WordGame
projects.description: A real-time multiplayer word game where players place letters on a shared board to create valid words. Timed turns, live scores, and competitive rounds make every match a test of vocabulary, strategy, and quick decisions.

projects.title: HandwritingAI
projects.description: An AI tool that converts typed text into realistic handwritten notes for assignments and documents. Users can choose handwriting styles and paper templates, adjust the look, and export their work as PDF or PNG files.

projects.title: Rajamantri
projects.description: A real-time multiplayer deduction game where players take hidden roles, bluff, and use strategy to discover the king. Players can create or join private rooms, chat live, reveal roles round by round, and play customizable matches with friends.

projects.title: MessMate
projects.description: A mobile mess management app built with a friend for students, administrators, and mess staff. It brings meal schedules, student voting, attendance, ratings, food-waste tracking, and role-based dashboards into one platform for more efficient and sustainable campus dining.

roadmap.description: My journey into programming began with learning the fundamentals of programming, problem-solving, and basic web technologies. During this time, I built a strong foundation in programming logic and software development concepts.

I started building responsive websites using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript while learning modern frontend development practices. I also explored version control with Git and GitHub and completed several personal projects.

I moved into React development and began building dynamic web applications. During this period, I also learned backend development using Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and REST APIs, allowing me to create complete full-stack applications.

I expanded my skills by working with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma, and PostgreSQL. I developed several full-stack projects while focusing on authentication, API integration, database management, and responsive user experiences.

I continue to improve as a Full Stack Developer by building production-ready applications, exploring Artificial Intelligence, cloud technologies, and scalable system design. My focus is on creating impactful software while continuously learning new technologies.
